quality_reasons: Agent made an unauthorized commitment to reimburse lost wages, which the supervisor had to walk back on the same call
Identity was properly verified (name, DOB, phone) before any discussion of the record
Supervisor handled the escalation well: opened a formal grievance with a reference number, approved the prep-kit cost, and rescheduled the procedure
Significant time lost to small talk, repeated screen timeouts, and audio/device issues, making an already long call inefficient
Diabetic insulin safety concern raised in passing was captured and routed to the GI nurse

flags.description: The agent promised reimbursement of lost wages without authority, a promise the supervisor explicitly could not honor.
flags.evidence: we'll definitely cover your lost wages. I'll make sure of it.

flags.description: The patient received contradictory prep instructions (text message vs. mailed packet), causing the cancelled colonoscopy.
flags.evidence: the text says clear liquids until two hours before. They say two different things!

flags.description: An insulin-dependent diabetic was left guessing her insulin doses during prep with no guidance, a safety gap only surfaced in passing near the end of the call.
flags.evidence: I'm diabetic, I'm on insulin. Nobody asked me about that last time either, and I was guessing on my insulin doses during the prep

action_items.task: Open formal grievance G-260411 regarding contradictory prep instructions and the cancelled colonoscopy; send written acknowledgment

action_items.owner: patient relations supervisor / grievance review committee
action_items.task: Include the patient's lost-wages reimbursement request in the grievance for committee review and provide a written response after review with the endoscopy center and text-reminder team
Cover/approve the cost of the second prep kit (approved on the call)
Call the patient before the rescheduled procedure to review prep in writing, including a specific insulin plan for prep day
Attend rescheduled colonoscopy at the same endoscopy center; bring photo ID, insurance card, and medication list

summary_notes: Patient Henrietta Moss-Okwuosa (DOB 7/17/1968) called to file a formal complaint after her 4/14 colonoscopy was cancelled by the anesthesiologist: her text reminder permitted clear liquids until 2 hours before arrival, but the mailed packet said nothing after midnight; she had black coffee at 6 AM and was cancelled. She completed prep, lost unpaid wages, and her sister lost a day. Agent Noor improperly promised lost-wage reimbursement; supervisor Celia Banerjee-Strom opened grievance G-260411, approved the ~$30 second prep kit, rescheduled the colonoscopy for Thu 4/30 at 7:30 AM, and arranged a GI nurse call to review prep and her insulin plan (patient is diabetic, on insulin, and guessed doses during prep). Patient prefers electronic communication; pharmacy on Ferris Avenue confirmed.
notable_details: Rescheduled colonoscopy: Thursday, April 30, arrival 7:30 AM, same endoscopy center
Patient is diabetic and insulin-dependent; she guessed her insulin doses during prep and no one asked about diabetes previously
Conflicting prep instructions: mailed packet said nothing to eat or drink after midnight; text message said clear liquids up to two hours before arrival
Lost-wages reimbursement is NOT guaranteed; it will be decided by the grievance review committee; only the second prep kit cost was approved
Patient prefers electronic communication over mailed documents
Preferred pharmacy confirmed as the one on Ferris Avenue
Cancellation process: patients can now reply to the reminder text to cancel
Agent's screen timed out twice due to a 2-minute idle logout and 30-day forced password changes; headset issues reported all week with IT 'looking into it'
